errors.description: dac_code_q is a multi-bit value produced in bus_clk and sampled directly in dac_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
load_pulse_q is a one-cycle bus_clk pulse consumed directly in dac_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
load_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample dac_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in dac_event_o.
slew_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector slew_mode_q before decoding in dac_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
bus_rst_n is used as data inside dac_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
analog_snapshot_q combines bus_clk payload state with dac_clk status state in analog_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
